notes.content:
BOO!! 👻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/953a133d5e233d80fa5ce4bd229c8c69b367dda5.gif[/img]

This year again we're bringing the Halloween spirit to Rip Them Off, starting today!

🎃The spookiest time of the year is nearly here and Rip Them Off wants to give you a fright with all-new content and seasonal customizations in this chilling limited-time event:
🎃

- The Halloween Map of Terrors! Creepy spiderwebs and awful bats await you in a brand new map with hair-raising music composed especially for the occasion.🦇🕸🕷
- Ghostly Dupes! A special new spooky animation sees the Dupes glide through the air without touching the ground. They might be dead, but they still have shopping fever! Perhaps that’s what they died of?👻
- New spine-tingling hidden items! Find hidden items in each map to see an atrocious animation!😱
- A terrifying new app icon.
- A hideous new title screen.
- Seasonal UI customizations that’ll make your skin crawl!

🎃Have fun with the Ghostly Dupes on the Halloween Map today! Oh, and don’t forget to keep following The Board’s recommendations!🎃

notes.title: FREE UPDATE: New Map of the Moment OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey friends,

Mat and Ava of Lozange Lab here. We hope you're all safe and well. 😃

Following the exciting launch of our latest game, Rip Them Off, we are moving full-speed into the free post-launch content plan we have for the game!

The first update, which is available right now, is a brand new Map of the Moment! 🥳

If you didn't know, on a regular rolling basis, we'll be releasing a Map of the Moment, this map will be one that is currently available, but we'll be shaking things up by changing and shifting aspects of the map, and adding fun modifiers to gameplay. With each Map of the Moment, you may find the Dupe entrances moved, different Dupe paths, less shops, more shops, shops in different places... The possibilities are endless!

Map of the Moment also allows us to experiment with new and interesting changes / modifiers to give your normal Rip Them Off gameplay experience a bit of a twist. 

With that said, we are excited to introduce the very first post-launch Map of the Moment!

[h2]Map of the Moment: Sanzu-no-kawa[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/baff5e1455d6313156ffee2b3c64b5c52a42a9a1.png[/img]

The classic shopping street of Sanzu-no-kawa has been turned on it's head with Map of the Moment. When you dive into Sanzu-no-kawa with Map of the Moment, you'll soon feel the changes to the established map. Entrances have been shifted and two spots for gameplay modifiers have shown up to the shopping party. For those of you who have this map nailed down to a tee, you'll find yourself needing to relearn the ropes — we really hope you don't disappoint The Board!

This Map of the Moment will stick around for 10 days or so, until the arrival of a very spooOOOoooky, seasonal event... Oops, we've said too much already!

Please do give it a go, and let us know what you think in the Rip Them Off Community Hub, we'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback.

Enjoy, and thank you again for your support!

Mat & Ava x

--

Be sure to follow us on your favourite social media platforms to stay up-to-date on everything Rip Them Off:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Lozange_Lab
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LozangeLab/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lozange.lab/

...and please do join us on Discord so that we can chat directly: https://discord.gg/U4bv5WA

notes.title: WE'RE LAUNCHING NEXT WEEK! Plus: leaderboards, post-launch, and a Swim Out sale!
notes.content:
Hey friends,

🤩📢 NEXT WEEK IS LAUNCH WEEK!! 🤩📢

We're so excited to be launching Rip Them Off on Steam next Thursday, September 24th, we can't wait to hear what you think of our jazzy tower defense puzzler. 

[h3]If you haven't already, we'd be forever grateful if you could please, please, please hit the [b]Wishlist [/b]button below.

That way you'll be notified upon release, and it'll help us to reach more people with Rip Them Off:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/1cc5f48ea6dc22b4e0750db535f63a5290f956ff.jpg[/img]
---

Now that we've all wishlisted Rip Them Off (😉), let's discuss two important and exciting features we recently implemented into Rip Them Off ready for launch, starting with leaderboards!

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]

That's right, leaderboards are ready and raring to go in Rip Them Off! This means that, at launch next week, you'll be able to take what you've learnt about being a corporate money-making machine, and challenge your friends (or rivals!) to a high-score battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/ecc863414519082f3b9af61896b13ae677c3f1df.png[/img]

Every map in Rip Them Off has it's own leaderboard, so consider this us challenging you to hit the top spot (or top three, we'll be kind) in every city. Don't forget we'll be hanging around on the leaderboards too (we're pretty good at this game, you know?), so come and show us what you've got!

[h2]Map of the Moment[/h2]

Map of the Moment is a key part of our post-launch plans for Rip Them Off, and we're super excited to about it!

On a regular rolling basis, we'll be releasing a Map of the Moment, this map will be one that is currently available, but we'll be shaking things up by changing and shifting aspects of the map, and adding fun modifiers to gameplay. With each Map of the Moment, you may find the Dupe entrances moved, different Dupe paths, less shops, more shops, shops in different places... The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/3f239aacfafd2cb16c500900eaf1e1de79a9a9f7.jpg[/img]

Map of the Moment also allows us to experiment with new and interesting changes / modifiers to give your normal Rip Them Off gameplay experience a bit of a twist. You'll see the first Map of the Moment arrive pretty soon after launch, so keep an eye out for them!

---

[h3]In other news, we're celebrating next week's launch of Rip Them Off with a 66% off sale on our strategic, turn-based puzzle game Swim Out!

From now until 5pm CEST / 4pm BST / 8am PT on Monday September 21st, Swim Out is 66% off on Steam — that's quite a bargain if we do say so ourselves![/h3]

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/662200/Swim_Out/

If you do pick up Swim Out (firstly, thank you so much!), then please do leave us a positive review on Steam, it helps immensely and the more people who pick up our games, the more we can make.

---

That's all from us for now. Again, we can't wait for you to dive into Rip Them Off, it's been a labour of love for us and we think you're going to love it. 

[h3]Rip Them Off releases on Thursday September 24th here on Steam for PC, Mac, and Linux, and remember, your Wishlist is invaluable to tiny indie dev teams like ours, so please consider adding Rip Them Off to yours:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/

Thank you, be safe.

Ava and Mat x

notes.title: DEV UPDATE: Beta feedback = better video game — check out our new changes!
notes.content:
Happy Thursday!

How is everyone holding up? We hope you're safe and well. :)

A couple of weeks ago, we hosted a closed beta test for Rip Them Off. If you were one of the many who took part, thank you! The feedback we received was immeasurably helpful, and it was just amazing to finally get our game into people's hands, if only for a little while.

Today, we thought we'd give you all a little development update so you can see what we learnt from running the beta test, and what changes have now been implemented based on our testers wonderful feedback. We used our Discord server to chat with our beta testers, and share screenshots and videos, it was really useful. Please do join our little community: https://discord.gg/U4bv5WA 

[h3]So, what did we learn from the beta test, and what changes are we making based on the beta feedback?[/h3]

Firstly, we were stunned to read that absolutely everyone said they loved the art style, the original concept, and the humour of the game. We also received loads of positive feedback about our original music, and testers were impressed by the level of polish of the game. This was great to hear!

The number of bug reports was also very low. The reported bugs were very specific to some configurations, and were fixed during the beta. We're now confident in the stability and quality of the game for the release on September 24th.

One point of feedback we received is that some players wanted more guidance, to better understand what is under the hood. However, this was not the case for everyone, so we've implemented an optional in-game manual, called "Retail Entrapment 101". This manual explains, with texts and graphs, how things work for the Dupes' entrances, the differences between shops, and also provides some tips to help players perform better. As it's written by Rik, the writer of Rip Them Off, the tone remains as humorous and satirical as the rest of the game. Reading it is optional, as it slightly spoils some of the mysteries of the game, so players who'd like to discover those by themselves may want to keep that in mind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/2f8e180e9ca8b1f2dcae87143f21a9ae863f4f68.png[/img]

Staying on the theme of guidance, we received feedback from the beta suggesting that the difficulty ramps up too early, so we added a few steps to the tutorial for a smoother learning curve. First one shop, then two, then two streets, three shops etc. These now appear one by one during the tutorial phase.

One of the questions we needed answering with the beta was "how should we divide the levels?". We implemented two options for our testers: 
[olist]
[*] Subdivision per "Objective": Each Milestone progressively increases the Number of Days and the Money Goal, each milestone being played on the exact same map as the Final Milestone Map.
[*] Subdivision per "District": Each Milestone progressively increases the Number of Shops and the number of Dupe Entrances, each milestone being played on a sub-section of the Final Milestone Map.
[/olist]
To see what players preference was, we set different subdivisions for each level and asked them what they preferred. And to our surprise the majority of answers was...both! So we've decided to keep both systems, some maps having the subdivision per objective while other the subdivision per district.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/14ca1e272059c2254e1344cfde617df84e797379.png[/img]

[h3]We've changed/added a whole bunch of other new things too, all based on the feedback we received in the beta:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've improved the menus: beta testers suggested navigating by a simple click on the left or the right side of the selected item. It was a great suggestion, so we implemented it and now it's so much quicker to change level or your save game.
[*] We've added handy visual indicators on the Dupes' entrances with their colour-coded frequencies and their daily progress.
[*] We received remarks from players that they'd like to know what their planned action is for as long as it's waiting to be executed, so we've added indicators at the bottom right of the screen that show the cost of the planned action, the type of shop you're going to buy, and whether or not it's an upgrade.
[*] Oh and while we were at it, we also improved the Dupes animation, we hope you like it!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/87e113bc1e81169faebd973c6bc95b856522a42c.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261637/87e113bc1e81169faebd973c6bc95b856522a42c.gif[/img]

So there you have it! Our beta test was a huge success, and has set us up nicely for Rip Them Off's launch on September 24th! Thank you once again to our lovely testers for your time, patience, and excellent feedback. :D

If you haven't already, we'd love it if you could please hit the big 'Wishlist' button below, so that you can be notified of when Rip Them Off is released, but also of further updates like this one as we head towards launch. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/

Stay safe,

Ava & Mat x
